page.overview:
What is Malik al-Wali?

Malik al-Wali is a seventh generation Assamite of the Medieval period and the sire of the infamous Nazirah. While in Jerusalem, he fed on a Christian crusader as a mortal Nazirah tried to murder the warrior. Promising the opportunity of vengeance upon the Christians, he inducted her into the clan.
